description:
The /tree command should display a header titled 'Session Tree' when opened.

**OBSERVED (Elixir):**
- No header is shown when /tree overlay opens

**EXPECTED (Node.js):**
A header row showing "Session Tree" appears at the top of the overlay.

**Where to fix:**
- The TreeSelector component (apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/tree_selector.ex) should render a header with "Session Tree" title
- The render/2 function needs to prepend this header to the tree lines
- Look at how other selectors (ModelSelector, SessionSelector) render their headers for reference

**Verification:**
Run /tree command in both Elixir and Node.js side-by-side and verify header appears in Node.js but not Elixir
title: opi-277.1: /tree missing header title
